metadata_ood: outside componentwise training ranges: original weights, no extrapolation
scope: Offline, fixed-density scalar operator pilot. Metadata-conditioned linear field correction in the moment nullspace; no coordinate covariance, no anisotropic relation correction, no joint geometry/bias estimation. HOLD_PHASE3.
decision: METADATA_PILOT_SUPPORTED only if all execution/certificate gates pass and BOTH metadata arms improve clean transfer RMSE by at least 5%, paired cloud-bootstrap upper ratio <1, no transfer field deteriorates >10%, posterior RMSE deterioration <=2%, nominal transfer coverage >=90%, and metadata clean transfer RMSE is no worse than the respective metadata-free nullspace ablation. Otherwise METADATA_HOLD. Finite-pilot criteria, not population guarantees. No test-based retuning or replacement seeds.
